The <b>Drifter's Cloak</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Equipment|equipment item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> which functions as an upgrade to the [[Hunter's Cloak]], replacing it in [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet's]] inventory.

== Function ==
Holding the [[Controls (Silksong)|JUMP]] button in mid-air allows Hornet to ride vertical updrafts of wind in the environment. This ability can also be used to glide down slowly from high places.

== How to Acquire ==
The [[Seamstress]] in the [[Far Fields]] sews an array of spines into Hornet's cloak as a reward for completing the <i>[[Flexile Spines]]</i> Wish. [[Hoker]]s must be attacked in order to collect the 25 necessary [[Spine Core]]s.
